title: Fresh eyes on the AI pages you use daily: the Inbox, the Sessions page, a session detail, the models page

chat.text: An Opus reviewer who saw none of today's work shoots each page at four widths and checks your own sentences as the acceptance test (first row near the top, no empty footer, the rail stays when a card opens, names you know), measures, fixes what it finds in a worktree, and leaves anything bigger as the next brief with the number that justifies it.
